confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge and the city context only; no live listings or booking pages were inspected, and July 2026 prices were not verified. Accommodation anchors are the least certain because they vary widely with season and surf-demand peaks. Restaurant anchors are more reliable but still approximate, and Sri Lankan prices have been volatile. Draught beer at 0.5 L is uncommon locally, so the beer anchor is an equivalent-volume estimate. Cocktail and wine anchors are estimated from the local beer price relationship because direct knowledge is weak.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on other Sri Lankan coastal surf and beach towns with similar tourist demand, such as Mirissa and Hikkaduwa, adjusted for Arugam Bay's smaller village scale and its ordinary-venue pricing relative to the south coast.
